page.overview:
What is Clockwork City of Goug?

The Clockwork City of Goug , also known as Goug Machine City, is a location in Final Fantasy Tactics. This mining city produces mechanical weapons with generation-old technology and is the hometown of Mustadio Bunansa and his father Besrudio.

Ramza Beoulve accompanied Mustadio to Goug to locate his father who was in trouble with the Baert Trading Company over the Taurus Zodiac Stone. Mustadio was captured and Ludovich Baert demanded the Stone. Mustadio told Baert the Stone was in a nearby chimney and Ramza was forced to fetch it for him. After Baert left, a battle ensued where Ramza and Mustadio were victorious. The stone Baert now possessed was revealed to be a fake.

Mustadio's father, Besrudio, continued to work on the ancient relics from a long-lost more advanced civilization he could unearth from the ruins beneath Goug. He discovered a metallic sphere that was activated by Ramza's Aquarius Stone, turning into Construct 8 that promptly joined Ramza's company. Mustadio later also discovered an apparatus that turned out to be an interdimensional transporter that brought Cloud to Ivalice.

Goug's outfitter only contains guns, pistols, and bows and crossbows as well as primary accessories.
